university: Tecnológico de Monterrey (Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey)

programme.title: Ingeniería en Tecnologías Computacionales (ITC); English-taught version: B.S. in Computer Science and Technology
programme.teaching_language: Spanish or English depending on campus; full English-taught plan only at Monterrey campus ('Completo en español / Completo en inglés'). Page: 'Este programa puede cursarse en español o inglés, en distintos campus'. Closest official equivalent of computer science.
programme.campus: Monterrey (only campus offering the full plan in English); full Spanish plan also at Chihuahua, Ciudad de México, Estado de México, Guadalajara, Puebla, Querétaro, San Luis Potosí, Santa Fe, Sonora Norte, Toluca; other campuses only up to 2nd semester
programme.how_found: WebSearch site:tec.mx for 'Ingeniería en Tecnologías Computacionales ITC', then programme page on tec.mx (ES and EN versions); EN URL https://tec.mx/en/engineering-and-sciences/bs-in-computer-science-and-technology

english.quote: Al menos 72 puntos en el TOEFL iBT o 40 puntos de EUC o su equivalente al nivel B2 del idioma inglés referenciado al MCER.
english.how_found: Admission requirements block for the English-taught version on the ITC programme page (EN page: 'At least 72 points on the TOEFL iBT, or 40 points on the EUC').
english.notes: This minimum applies to admission to the English-taught ITC (Monterrey, 'Admisión al programa con cupo limitado'). For the Spanish-taught track there is no published English admission minimum: applicants take the EUC placement exam or submit TOEFL iBT/B2 First/PET/Pearson, and 'All Tec students have as a requirement to demonstrate B2 English proficiency' (graduation requirement; A1/A2 results require English courses) per https://tec.mx/en/undergraduate. The English programme also requires C1 (MCER) to graduate and >=75% credits in English. No Spanish-proficiency requirement for foreign applicants was found on the pages read.

value.description: No published minimum average or admission-test cut-off. Holistic decision on GPA, admission test (PAA, or SAT/ACT), résumé and essay. An average below 80/100 triggers a profile review with possible additional requirements, not automatic rejection.

gpa.quote: El ensayo y tu currículo son elementos determinantes para tomar una decisión de admisión.
gpa.how_found: Admission process section of the undergraduate (profesional) admissions page; EN equivalent at https://tec.mx/en/undergraduate
gpa.notes: Also on the same page: 'Si tu promedio es menor a 80, revisaremos tu perfil académico y extracurricular' (applicant is then told which additional requirements to meet). EN page: 'The decision of the Admissions Committee is final'. Tests accepted: PAA, SAT or ACT (no minimum published for admission). ITC is not in the 'cupo límite' or 'ranqueo' lists for August 2027 (those are ARQ, BA, BGB, BM, BBA, LAF, IBT, INA, IDM, IMD, MC, MO / BFI, BBA, BEF, MC). Kazakhstan NIS grade-12 diploma recognition not addressed on pages read.

deadline.quote: Fechas importantes para ingreso en agosto 2027
deadline.how_found: 'Fechas de admisión continua' table under the August 2027 heading on the Spanish profesional admissions page.
deadline.notes: Admission is ROLLING (admisión continua): you complete your file by a cut-off and get results ~12 days later. The table for August 2027 currently lists cut-offs from 3 Oct 2026 to '28 de noviembre 2026' (results '10 de diciembre 2026'); 2026-11-28 is the latest listed cut-off, NOT a stated final closing date, and no sentence says the process ends there. In the August 2026 cycle (EN page, 'The dates currently shown apply to students beginning in August 2026') rolling cut-offs ran to July 18 (results July 30), so later 2027 dates may be added. No separate deadline for international applicants is published; ITC is not a 'cupo límite' programme in the table (though the English-track page says 'Admisión al programa con cupo limitado' and admission depends on seat availability). Scholarship applicants (Beca al Talento Académico Internacional) must be admitted by 'Límite de admisión: 20 de enero de 2027.'

tuition.quote: Recuerda que la información es referencial y esencial para tu planificación educativa.
tuition.how_found: Spanish and English undergraduate tuition pages, policies tuition page, inversioneducativa.tec.mx policies page, Study in Mexico FAQ.
tuition.notes: Degree-programme tuition is only shown through an interactive JavaScript simulator (by programme and campus); no amount is in the page text, and no tuition PDF was found. Tuition is charged per credit (typical load 18 credits/semester). Only related published figure: Study in Mexico FAQ (https://studyinmexico.tec.mx/en/faq, aimed at exchange/independent visiting students, undated): 'A credit at the Tec costs approximately $10,200MXN or $600USD.' and 'The full academic load during semester periods is 18 credits.' (≈183,600 MXN/semester by arithmetic, not a published degree figure). No separate international rate is mentioned. Application fee $2,000 MXN (from January 2026); place reservation $5,000-8,000 MXN (EN undergraduate page).

value.name: Beca al Talento Académico (Academic Talent Scholarship)

scholarship_exists.quote: Dirigida a estudiantes con un promedio de 90/100 en sus estudios de preparatoria.
scholarship_exists.how_found: Undergraduate scholarships page (tec.mx/es/profesional/becas), linked from the admissions page.
scholarship_exists.notes: Requirements on page: average >= 90/100 and PAA >= 1,360 (SAT/ACT converted); 'El porcentaje de beca puede ser de 20% hasta 60% sobre el costo de la colegiatura'. A separate 'Beca al Talento Académico Internacional' (40%-60%, August 2027 call, apply from 24 Aug 2026, closes 22 Jan 2027) is restricted to Latin American/Caribbean countries; Kazakhstan is NOT on its list. The 'Beca Socioeconómica' international version is 'Disponible para estudiantes provenientes de países de Latinoamérica'. Educational loan requires Mexican nationality.

scholarship_international.quote: Academic Talent. Designed to attract students with high academic performance to pursue their studies regardless of family economic situation or nationality.
scholarship_international.how_found: Regulations on Scholarships and Educational Loans for High School and Undergraduate Students (2026 amendments), official PDF linked from the EN undergraduate page; text extracted from the PDF and grep-verified.
scholarship_international.notes: The regulation says Academic Talent is awarded regardless of nationality, and the becas page lists no nationality restriction for Beca al Talento Académico. Caveat: the country-specific 'Beca al Talento Académico Internacional' excludes Kazakhstan, and the 'Estudiantes internacionales' profile section on the becas page did not render (JS), so confirm eligibility with admisiones@servicios.tec.mx. Age limit under 21 at application applies to talent scholarships.

access_notes: tec.mx is behind Imperva/Incapsula: plain curl requests returned HTTP 403 with an Incapsula challenge page (one early request to a guessed URL returned 404). No bypass attempted; pages were read through the WebFetch tool, which returns extracted text with quotes capped at ~125 characters. As a result, quotes from tec.mx HTML pages could not be byte-checked against raw HTML; they are as returned by the extraction tool. The scholarship regulation PDF quote was checked against text extracted from the downloaded PDF.

Programme and admissions pages are JavaScript-heavy: the tuition simulator (costos-de-colegiatura) renders no figures in page text; the 'Soy estudiante extranjero(a)' and 'Estudiantes internacionales' profile sections on the admissions and becas pages did not render content.

tec.mx/en/undergraduate still shows August 2026 dates ('The dates for 2027 admission will be available soon.'), while tec.mx/es/profesional already shows 'Fechas importantes para ingreso en agosto 2027'. Spanish page used as the current source.
tec.mx/en/undergraduate/scholarships returned 404. The international programs regulations PDF (2026) covers exchange/double-degree programmes, not degree admission of foreign applicants.
